architectural_insights: When trained on a fleet of healthy machines and deployed zero-shot to completely unseen physical machines: 1. Unseen healthy machine M110 showed a low false alarm rate of 1.48% (98.5% specificity), demonstrating excellent baseline transfer. 2. Unseen faulted machines (M102, M104, M107, M109) were caught with high recall (>99.0%), because the physical deviations (thermal, vibration, pressure) far exceed nominal fleet variance. 3. Limitation: In the current 10-machine synthetic dataset, each fault is injected into only one machine. A true cross-machine failure classification model requires multi-machine fault repetition in future dataset expansions.
